_comment: Roads closed to Apex tankers, written into the OSM extract before Valhalla builds its tiles. A ban with "always": true becomes hgv=no (closed at every hour); one with banned_from/banned_to becomes hgv:conditional, which Valhalla applies from each trip's real departure time (Africa/Cairo local hours). Owner's rules, 2026-11-27: 26th of July and the Ahmed Hamdi tunnels are closed at all hours; the Cairo Ring Road is open at all hours and is deliberately absent.

bans.label: Ahmed Hamdi tunnel
bans._comment: Both tunnels under the canal at Suez: the original and the northern one (Ahmed Hamdi 2). Only the tunnel ways: the approach roads share the name and stay open.
